governing_principles: 1. Zero post-hoc hyperparameter tuning, threshold re-selection, or rule modification.
2. Single-pass inference execution under locked model checkpoints and frozen operating policies.
3. Evaluation of all models across the 3 audited random seeds (42, 123, 456).
4. Transparent reporting of both primary frozen operating policies and threshold-independent ranking metrics (ROC-AUC, AP, Brier).

target_cohort_minimum_specifications.workload_independence: Must originate from a distinct cluster, trace, or administrative domain (e.g. Google Borg 2019, Alibaba 2018 cluster trace, Azure VM trace, or independent LANL HPC logs).
target_cohort_minimum_specifications.telemetry_features: Must provide telemetry mappable to the 31 Borg features (CPU utilization, memory usage, disk I/O, network transfer, page faults).
target_cohort_minimum_specifications.temporal_resolution: 5-minute continuous sampling intervals; minimum 60-minute duration per entity (12 continuous steps: 7 historical + 5 recent).
target_cohort_minimum_specifications.entity_and_job_grouping: Must provide unique task/instance identifiers (entity_id) and workload parent job identifiers (parent_job_id) to evaluate within-job ranking and cross-job false alarm rates.
target_cohort_minimum_specifications.label_semantics: Ground truth labels mapped to NORMAL (0), WARNING (1: failure within 10-25m), and CRITICAL (2: failure within 5m).
